title: Dungeon
description: A dungeon: its zones and floors, the floor generator's knobs, its curios, traps, room templates, Pacts and difficulty presets (03-GAME-DESIGN §4, §11, §12; the content of 07-DUNGEONS.md §2, §6). One file per dungeon at content/dungeons/<dungeon>/dungeon.json; its room templates may be split out to content/dungeons/<dungeon>/templates/<id>.json (each validating against #/$defs/template) and are merged by the loader. Monsters and encounters are separate files that point here by dungeonId.

levelRange.description: Monster levels from the first floor to the last (§11.4: Gravehollow L1–14).

unlockedBy.description: The dungeon whose final boss opens this one (§11.4); null for the first.

templates.description: Room templates written inline; templates/<id>.json files are added to this list by the loader.

pacts.description: The Pact modifier menu (§11.2, 07 §6.2); may be empty until Phase 7.

presets.description: The three launch difficulty presets as knob sets (§11.2, §12.1, 07 §6.1). Normal is the baseline.

secrets.description: Secret rooms (03 §4.3, 07 §2.6): what a found secret holds. Secrets reward, never gate. Optional until Phase 3 writes them.

zone.description: 3–4 floors with one monster family, at most one hunter and one or more bosses (§1, §11.3; 07 §2.3). A zone that carries the dungeon's last floor lists its zone boss and the final boss; the throne floor may also be its own hunter-less zone.

hunterId.description: Monster id with the hunter block; null for a zone with no hunter (the throne floor).

bossIds.description: Monster ids with the boss block, in floor order; each sits on the floor whose bossId names it. The linter checks every one exists and is placed on a floor of this zone.

waystone.description: Whether beating the zone boss opens a Waystone to start later delves here.

biomeKitId.description: The art kit (tiles, props, lighting) the zone's templates use (07 §2.2).

monsterLevel.description: The floor band level (§11.2; 06: F1 L1 · F2 L2 · F3 L4 …).

lightAtEntry.description: Light 0–100 the entry lantern sets when the party arrives below it (§4.2, 07 §2.3).

encounterTableIds.description: The tables this floor draws from with equal weight, never the same twice in a row (07 §2.3); each matches encounters' tableId.

eliteAffixCount.description: Affixes an Elite room's champion carries (§11.1: 1 on floors 1–2, 2 on 3–6, 3 on 7+).

trapBand.description: Trap difficulty range on this floor (§4.3: 8–60 by band).

secretChance.description: Chance of a secret room (§4.3: about 25).

secretDifficulty.description: Detection needed to see the secret door (07 §2.3, §2.6).

merchant.description: A Merchant room is placed; always true on the floor before a zone boss (§8.4).

hunterClock.description: Floor-clock ticks before the zone's hunter enters (§4.5: 40); null for no hunter (boss floors).

bossId.description: The boss on this floor (one of the zone's bossIds), or null.

lightAtArena.description: The light the boss arena sets on entry (07 §2.8); null on floors without a boss.

generator.description: The mission-graph grammar and its knobs (§11.1, 07 §2.10).

roomWeights.description: Roll weights for the rolled room kinds (§4.6); the linter checks they sum to 100. Fixed kinds (entry, stairs, boss, secret, keyRoom, lockedDoor) are placed by the grammar and are left out or 0.

grammar.description: Rewrite rules, one per string, applied in order by the generator (e.g. 'START -> entry PATH stairs', 'PATH -> room PATH | room').

keyLockChance.description: Chance of one Key-and-Lock pair per floor (§11.1: 30).

secretChance.description: Default secret-room chance when a floor does not override it (§11.1: 25).

maxBranches.description: Side branches off the guaranteed path (§11.1: up to 3).

bossFarthest.description: Boss rooms are farthest from the entry by room count (§11.1).

grid.description: The coarse layout grid in cells (07 §2.10: 8 × 6).

curio.description: An interactable with a choice (§4.6, 07 §2.4). A safe item or a gate on a choice turns the gamble into a purchase.

zoneId.description: The zone whose floors roll it; null for any zone of the dungeon.

requires.description: Gates on the choice (07 §2.4: a Torch consumed, Foraging rank 3+, Detection ≥ 14, Strength ≥ 14, Lockpicking vs 12, a 0.05 R stake). A choice whose only requirement is the curio's safeItemId is the purchase. Empty means always offered.

outcomes.description: Rolled once; the linter checks the chances sum to 100. Empty means nothing happens.

safeItemId.description: The item that makes the good outcome certain (§4.6: Holy Water on a sarcophagus); null when the safe choice is a skill rank or there is none.

trap.description: A trap (§4.3, 07 §2.5): revealed on entering when best Detection ≥ difficulty (or by the listed class, pet or field skill); disarmed by Trap Disarm; otherwise it fires on its trigger.

zoneId.description: The zone whose floors roll it; null for any zone.

difficulty.description: 8–60 by floor band; the Disarm roll is 50% + 2% × (rank × 5 − difficulty / 2).

trigger.description: What fires it when unrevealed: enter (the room), step (a tile or the midline), open (a door, chest or niche), loot (picking up the room's treasure), time (standing in the room for a tick, or the light being low on entry).

triggerNote.description: The exact trigger as the designer wrote it ('the whole party crossing the N doorway'); the sim owns a hook per trap id.

revealedBy.description: How the party sees it before it fires. Detection is always a reveal; the rest are 'always' reveals.

detection.description: Best party Detection that reveals it; usually the difficulty.

classId.description: A class that always reveals it (an Arcanist reads the Warding Glyph); null when none.

petId.description: A pet species that always reveals it (a Cellar Hound smells the Loose Flagstone); null when none.

fieldSkillRank.description: A field-skill rank that always reveals it (Cartography rank 2+); null when none.

criticalScout.description: A critical scout from the previous room reveals it.

effects.description: What triggering it does, in order (a failed disarm fires them at half). Target defaults to the lowest-Perception hero; a line's target overrides (partyFront, allAllies, room).

blocksDoor.description: Whether it must be disarmed or triggered to pass.

disarmReward.description: What a successful disarm yields besides field-skill XP (07 §2.5: '2 Rawhide, 0.01 R' is a material line and a gold line).

template.description: A room set piece on the coarse grid (§11.1 step 3, 07 §2.2): footprint, door sockets, the kinds it can host, the fixed camera, its props and its render budgets.

doors.description: Door sockets; the layout pass only joins rooms where sockets meet.

offset.description: Cells from the side's left/top corner.

kinds.description: Room kinds this template can be dressed as.

fov.description: Vertical field of view in degrees.

lightSource.description: A brazier or the like that restores light (§4.2).

triBudget.description: Static triangles the dressed room may hold after instancing (07 §2.2: under 30 k).

drawCallBudget.description: Draw calls the dressed room may issue (07 §2.2: under 60).

knobs.description: The difficulty scalars (§11.2, 07 §6.1). Percentages are of Normal (100 = unchanged); every key is optional so a Pact may move one knob.

eliteRoomWeight.description: Replaces generator.roomWeights.elite (07 §6.1: 8 / 11 / 14); the difference comes out of fight.

lightStart.description: Light at delve start, overriding the first floor's lightAtEntry (07 §6.1: 100 / 80 / 60).

revivesPerFloor.description: Party revive budget per floor (§12.1: Normal 3, Hard 1, Dread 0).

trapDifficultyBonus.description: Added to every rolled trap difficulty (07 §6.1: 0 / 4 / 8).

retreatTollPercent.description: Share of the delve's gold a Waystone-less retreat costs (§12.3: 10 / 15 / 25).

goldPercent.description: Gold found, in percent of Normal (07 §6.1: 100 / 125 / 160).

xpPercent.description: XP before the D curve, in percent of Normal (07 §6.1: 100 / 115 / 130).

chestShiftPp.description: Percentage points moved from an in-dungeon chest's centre toward +1 grade (07 §6.1 Hard: 10).

chestCentreShift.description: Grades an in-dungeon chest's centre moves up (07 §6.1 Dread: 1).

bossExtraRareParts.description: Extra rare parts on a boss's first kill (07 §6.1: 0 / 1 / 1).

finalBossExtraShards.description: Extra Divine Shards on a final boss's first kill (07 §6.1 Dread: 1).

pact.description: A named modifier the party opts into for a reward (§11.2, 07 §6.2). Weights sum to the party's Oath; the sim applies the chest shift at Oath 6 and 12.

weight.description: 1–3; 3 only for a Pact that can end the delve by itself.

ruleFlags.description: Rule flags the sim implements by name where a knob cannot say it ('no-minimap', 'no-retreat', 'twin-hunter', 'wear-x1.5'); empty when the knobs say everything.

chestShiftPp.description: Percentage points in-dungeon chests shift toward +1 grade.

secret.description: A secret room's contents (07 §2.6): reward lines, a floor-long blessing, a shortcut to the exit or a map reveal.

zoneId.description: The zone whose floors roll it; null for any zone.

chest.description: A chest in the room, or null.

blessing.description: A buff that lasts the floor (Warm Hands, Vigil, Undertow), or null.

shortcutToExit.description: A crawlway or stair to the exit room: reveals it and costs no ticks.

lightBonus.description: Light restored on finding it (0 for none).

fieldSkillXp.description: A field skill the find trains (Cartography for a lore tablet), or null.
